# chronosphere_metric_name_active_series_limit (Resource)

A per-metric-name cap on the number of active time series accepted over the active time series rolling window. This resource is backed by Chronosphere's unstable config API and is subject to breaking change without notice.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "chronosphere_metric_name_active_series_limit" "http_requests_total" {
  name              = "http_requests_total active series limit"
  slug              = "http-requests-total-active-series-limit"
  metric_name       = "http_requests_total"
  max_active_series = 100000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `max_active_series` (Number) The total active time series allowed for this metric name over the active time series rolling window. Must be greater than zero.
- `metric_name` (String) The exact `__name__` this limit applies to. Only one limit may exist per metric name.
- `name` (String) Display name of the metric name active series limit.

### Optional

- `slug` (String) Stable identifier for the metric name active series limit. Generated from `name` if omitted. Immutable after creation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
